title: Type-I CGX Ingest-to-Maturity Operational Contract
purpose: Operationalize UTP-148/149 so new source bytes, CAD/geometry revisions, material lots, process records, calibration, measurements, seed revisions and contradictions are converted into attributable evidence envelopes, dependency invalidation, maturity deltas, next-witness work and DBR receipts without silent overwrite or authority uplift.

owners.source_owner_rule: Owner engineering records remain authoritative; UTP-150 is the mutation/orchestration contract, not a replacement master.

contradiction_policy.rule: Contradictory evidence is retained as a first-class branch and may lower/hold dependent claims; it is never deleted merely because newer evidence exists.
contradiction_policy.promotion_gate: No contradicted claim may advance until the contradiction is explicitly resolved by scope, measurement, source authority or owner review.

maturity_delta_record.rule: Record prior and current state per axis plus reason/evidence ref. Never average axes into a readiness percentage.
maturity_delta_record.physical_ceiling: Digital ingest, CI, simulation, render or AI analysis cannot advance physical_evidence beyond BUILD_READY/M6.

priority: only then scale to integrated system

seed_graph_policy.SG-0: Every active/passive mechanism must be supported by local material/process/test evidence; seed absence is not capability evidence.
seed_graph_policy.SG-1: One exact seed/revision plus every printed interface/coupling edge are tracked independently.
seed_graph_policy.SG-N: Every seed and consequential coupling/failure edge is explicit; system claim ceiling is bounded by the weakest required node/edge.

numeric_inference_policy.capacitance: Use UTP-149 CAP-1..7. Arbitrary 3D/multiconductor cases require attributable Maxwell capacitance matrix/field solve; do not force parallel-plate assumptions.
numeric_inference_policy.radiative_energy: Available source power, losses, aperture/coupling and environment bound radiative/harvesting claims; geometry does not create energy.

operational_surfaces.filespace: source bytes, hashes, object/revision, CAD/process/material/calibration/evidence lineage
operational_surfaces.dataspace: state transitions, invalidations, numeric/symbolic/HOLD outputs, measurements, uncertainty, receipts
operational_surfaces.printspace: region/interface/process sequence, seed topology, as-built/configuration and physical witness state
operational_surfaces.lsgo: project maturity vector, contradiction count/state, invalidated dependents, next witness and evidence ceiling; no readiness percentage

hard_boundaries: no new master or duplicate datastore
no durable .cgx carrier/root mutation without reviewed promotion
no physical execution from this contract

initial_proof_fixtures.change: Kapton HN dielectric source revision or lot changes
expected_preservation: raw prior measurement with historical lineage
printed mechanical structure evidence not dependent on seed revision

expected_invalidation: acceptance/uncertainty claims depending on that calibration
